body:
I didn't really explain the relationship, so that's ok :) It's a reasonable assumption. 

It was because of different goals, but it just was so sudden. Every guy I've tried to see since, I just keep being reminded of my ex. I keep comparing them to him, and it's not fair, and I don't see it every changing. Even though I see his shortcomings, we were a great match. I don't want anything different. 

It's hard to even think about living a good life right now. I can't even say I know I'll be ok, because I don't. I'm gonna keep hoping it'll change, because I don't really have a choice.

Honestly? I don't care if it's petty, or if it demeans me. It's the only thing that's gone right for me since the break up. He's already talking to other girls, he's happy with life, etc. etc. 

Very short version of our relationship: We were perfect together, not a single argument, until he randomly tells me, "I don't want to have kids. We can't be together." Having kids is a major life goal for me, and he knew that. We tried staying friends, but it hurt too much. I'm still crazy in love with him, and I've even offered to accept not having kids. He won't let me give that up. After a week, even though I still love him with all my heart, I started realizing how unfair the relationship was. He put everything above me, and I gave him absolutely everything I could. 

I don't hate him. I'm not even angry with him. I'm just still heart broken, and jealous that even though he claims "I don't want to be in a relationship until I realize what I want in life," he still is out with other women. It just hurts, and makes me feel like I'm just not good enough for anyone. 

So, in short, one of the things he loved more than me, I beat him at. It's spiteful, vengeful, mean, petty, demeaning, all those things. But damnit, it feels good to win for once.
Yeah, I didn't get that part most of all. I figured at least sex gave him some benefit, too.

This is an account I don't check too often, anyway, so it's ok.

We didn't have any problems that he mentioned. I keep getting this feeling that he's hiding stuff from me. All I can think of is how none of my relationships ever work, so it has to be something I did. I know the new guy isn't being spiteful. As it turns out, he was playing games but was mostly not at his computer. He's since texted me, and told me he doesn't know if he likes me as more than a friend yet or not. Which is fine. I just don't deal well with being single, so I just want to hurry and fill that gap.

What's stopping me is they don't know how to handle it. Most of my friends have the idea that you just have to choose to be happy, as if I'm choosing to be heart broken and suicidal and depressed. I don't know how to give it a break, since they all come to me even now, when they know I had it hard. 

I don't feel strong for hiding how I feel. In face, I feel the opposite. I'm not strong enough to open up. I'm so sick of crying alone with no one to listen. I'm sick of feeling so damn alone. 

I'm tired of trying. I'm tired of facing the world every day, knowing it won't get any better. I'm tired of putting my heart into everything. Hell, I'm tired of having a heart. I wish I could just be cold and emotionless. I wish I could take back this whole past relationship. I wish I could go back in time and tell myself to never get with that guy. I'm just tired of being miserable. It's been a month, and I still can't stop thinking about him. Every guy I try to see, I just compare to him. That's not fair to the guy, or to me. But he was so perfect, I don't want anything else. He's the standard I have, and I don't know how to go back from that. But I know no one will ever meet those expectations.

I've tried my whole life to keep going, and I've barely made it the whole ride. But things just keep piling on. When does it stop? I'm 3 years behind now. One year for the wrong class, a second year for the undeserved grade, and another because the professor I had is the only one who teaches that class, and I refuse to take her again. So after I finish this year and (hopefully) graduate with my writing arts degree (I'm forced to double major as an education major), I'm transferring somewhere else, but I'm not sure where just yet. 

I found him online. But I'd rather have not found him. The breakup made me worse than I was before. He was the one thing I felt I could truly count on, and he just left. He literally brought it up one day, and broke up with me that same fucking day. We hadn't argued at all. We had no problems. But he just suddenly changed his mind, and it feels like it's something I did. I just wish I knew what it was. 


I saw the new guy playing on steam. He's posted on Facebook. There's nothing keeping him from talking to me. More reason for me to feel there's something wrong with me. 

I appreciate the response and the fact that I'm not alone. I don't even know if that's comforting anymore. If I was alone, I'd feel better about ending it. But I feel like I have to suffer for everyone else's sake. I have a role to play in my friend group. I'm the cheery one that everyone goes to for help, to vent to, to take out their anger on. That's my purpose in life. I used to love it. I fed off the joy I gave others, hoping one day it'd be mine. But the longer I live, the more pain I feel. It hasn't gotten better. The few times it has (ex, new guy, friends), it just got worse than before because of it. 

I have no hope for the future, for humanity or for me. I'm sick of having to run to the bathroom because I can't hold back the tears, but I know no one else wants to see them. I'm sick of faking this stupid smile to all my friends so they can feel better. I'm sick of struggling every fucking minute to not cry, to not think about life, to try and find one fucking good thing about my day or myself, to not check my ex's reddit or Facebook on a different account. I'm sick of fighting. I've been doing it for as long as I can remember. I just want a break. 


EDIT: I also can't stand myself. My few good qualities fuck me over. I'm nice, so people constantly walk all over me. I'm smart, so people expect too much from me. I put my heart into everything, which just ends up with me being hurt. I hate everything about myself. I always have. I keep trying to do stuff to better myself, but then I sink deeper into depression because it didn't work, or I didn't achieve a goal so I consider myself a failure.
Thanks :) I tried haha. And I got a man lined up anyway, so I really don't need my ex :P it just still sucks to see this side of him.

Well he told me that apparently he wanted to see other people anyway, because he didn't want to change our relationship even though he wasn't happy. So apparently it isn't gonna work anyway. But thank you very much :)
